                                                       cameraCol = "Camera.Serial.Number",

                                                       minDeltaTime = 60)

Thanks for any help and I apologize for my English

Eduven, student of Biology

messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Duplicate records
messages.body_plain:
Hi Eduven,

any chance you can run recordTable on the images instead of assessTemporalIndependence? recordTable should filter such records (if requested by the user) via argument removeDuplicateRecords , which is TRUE by default.

What exactly do you mean by pseudo-replica records? All data of those records are identical, including file names?

LIke I said in other threads on the group, assessTemporalIndependence is just one of many internal functions of recordTable, and using it in isolation may lead to unexpected behaviour as in your case. It is really only a workaround for users who have a spreadsheet record table without the images and wish to filter for temporal independence.

Best regards,

Jürgen

messages.subject: Re: R Code for Extracting Independent Events
messages.subject_clean: R Code for Extracting Independent Events
messages.body_plain:
Hi Nia,
search in the forum for the keyword "assessTemporalIndependence". It is an internal function of camtrapR that can be used for filtering a record table by time differences. It's not a pretty solution and doesn't do any of the checks that camtrapR normally does, but it seems to work.

Based on your code, here's an example.

colnames(df) <- c("Species", "Station", "DateTimeOriginal", "Date", "Time")
df$Station <- as.character(df$Station)

df_filt <- camtrapR:::assessTemporalIndependence(df,
                                      deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastIndependentRecord",
                                      stationCol = "Station",
                                      camerasIndependent = FALSE,
                                      columnOfInterest = "Species",
                                      minDeltaTime = 30)    # minutes

You may also want to look at the difference between deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastIndependentRecord" and "lastRecord". For more details on that, see ?recordTable

Please don't use any assessTemporalIndependence scripts files I may have attached to previous threads. Better to install the latest version of camtrapR and then use the internal function with camtrapR:::assessTemporalIndependence()

Is the output what you'd expect? Seemed ok at first glance, but please check thoroughly.

Best regards,
Jürgen

messages.subject_clean: [camtrapR] Step to step guide for camtrapR
messages.body_plain:
Dear Letro,

there are four vignettes which explain the entire workflow. The sample data these vignettes use are in the package, so you can follow along.

You can find them on the CRAN page <https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/camtrapR/> (under Vignettes, they are numbered 1-4), on the github page <https://jniedballa.github.io/camtrapR/> (under Articles), or directly within R(Studio): ?`camtrapR-package`

Also, see the original publication <https://besjournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/2041-210X.12600> which explains the workflow (note it's a few years old, and there are some new functions by now).

If you are new to R, I suggest to first get familiar with the basics of R before using camtrapR, to avoid unnecessary frustration.

Best regards,

Jürgen
